verdicts.ar: رحم الله أبا مسهر، ما كان أثبته
verdicts.en: God have mercy on Abu Mushir; how firm he was.

verdicts.ar: ثقة، ما رأيت أفصح منه ممن كتبنا عنه
verdicts.en: Reliable; I have not seen anyone more eloquent among those we wrote from.

bio: The leading hadith scholar of Damascus in his generation. He was imprisoned in Baghdad during the Inquisition over the createdness of the Qur'an and died there.

provenance.ref: Taqrib al-Tahdhib, entry 3738, https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/تقريب_التهذيب/حرف_العين/ذكر_بقية_أسماء_الآباء_فيمن_اسمه_عبد_الله (ثقة فاضل: a single ثقة = rank 3)
